Author: George Kalangi. License: MIT, included as LICENSE.
Source: https://github.com/georgeykalangi/calhacks-kit

Mentor page: https://georgekalangi.vercel.app/calhacks

All files under the upstream skills/ directory were copied byte-for-byte to .agents/skills/. This includes six SKILL.md files, the HACK template, event preset, catalog, secret patterns, deck template and themes. No skill instructions were rewritten. SHA256SUMS records the local copies. README.md is an upstream reference; its example asset paths refer to the original repository.

The mentor kit is unofficial. The bundled event preset is dated October 16, 2026 and includes provisional information and prior-event examples. The current event deadline and verified sponsor guidance in this project's HACK.md and docs/08_SPONSORS_AND_COSTS.md take precedence. The project's operating assumptions avoid asking questions already answered by the user and the plan.
